title: Sentence Foundations — Final Review

questions.explanation: 'The report' is the subject, 'is' is the verb, and 'ready' completes the description.

options: I check my email every morning.
I my email check every morning.
Check my email I every morning.
questions.explanation: Use subject + verb + object + time: I + check + my email + every morning.

questions.prompt: My colleague ___ the reports every Friday.
questions.explanation: 'My colleague' is one person, so the simple-present verb is 'reviews'.

questions.prompt: Choose a or an: 'She received ___ important message.'
questions.explanation: 'Important' begins with a vowel sound, so use 'an' before 'important message'.

options: I finished the report I sent it yesterday.
I finished the report, and I sent it yesterday.
questions.explanation: The comma and 'and' join two complete ideas correctly.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'I'll send the report ___ Maria ___ Friday.'
questions.explanation: Use 'to' for the recipient and 'on' for the day: I'll send the report to Maria on Friday.

achievementRule: Complete six lessons and submit final review

instructions.en: Review the six foundation lessons. Complete all six questions; your score is feedback, not a proficiency label.
instructions.taglish: Balikan ang anim na foundation lessons. Sagutan ang anim na tanong; feedback lang ang score, hindi English proficiency label.
